# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 and performance improvements** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 upgrades to Skia m151 and delivers significant managed-layer performance improvements. This release upgrades the Skia engine to chrome/m151, fixes a native resource leak in SKImage, and includes a focused performance pass: managed color conversions, allocation-free HarfBuzz UTF-8 encoding, zero-copy shaper spans, and reduced string allocations across the API.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia upgraded to milestone m151** — The bundled Skia engine is now built from chrome/m151, with multiple rounds of upstream stability and bug fix merges included. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))
- **WASM Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries for .NET 11** — New WASM static libraries built with Emscripten 5.0.6 (with the new exnref exception-handling model) are included for upcoming .NET 11 WASM support. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487))

## API Surface

- **SKColor hex parsing optimized with ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads** — SKColor.Parse and TryParse now have ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads and an optimized hex parser, reducing allocations in color-from-string scenarios. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) fixed** — A native handle was not being released when the cropped region was identical to the full image, causing a resource leak. The handle is now correctly freed. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed color conversion ported away from P/Invoke** — SKColor-to-SKColorF conversion and SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply operations are now implemented in managed integer math, eliminating per-call native round-trips. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8 made allocation-free** — AddUtf8(string) now pools its UTF-8 encoding buffer rather than allocating on every call, removing a hot-path allocation in text shaping. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376))
- **SKShaper glyph results read via zero-copy spans** — Glyph and cluster arrays from HarfBuzz are now read through Span instead of copies, reducing allocations in every shaping call. ([#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))
- **Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse de-allocated** — The per-call char[4] allocation in HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse has been removed using stackalloc. ([#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with this release, with performance improvements to AddUtf8 (allocation-free pooled UTF-8 encoding) and Tag.Parse (stack-allocated, no heap allocation).
